questions.question: Calculate 1,85 ÷ 4, showing where the comma goes and how you continued the division.
questions.expected_answer: Comma above comma: 18 tenths ÷ 4 = 4 r 2; 25 hundredths ÷ 4 = 6 r 1; add a zero: 10 ÷ 4 = 2 r 2; add a zero: 20 ÷ 4 = 5. Answer 0,4625 km (462,5 m).

questions.question: Explain how to round 2 ÷ 7 to two decimal places and why R50 ÷ 3 needs care in a money context.
questions.expected_answer: Divide to three places: 0,285, then round to 0,29. R50 ÷ 3 = 16,666… ≈ R16,67, but 3 × R16,67 = R50,01, so in practice one person pays R16,66; the context decides.
